mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and subsequently negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST MoM > 10% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1%, it signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 200,000 and UNRATE MoM < -0.5% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 5% year-over-year and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable (YoY change within 1%), it signals strong demand without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS YoY > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY within 1%
failure_condition: If RSAFS YoY > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY within 1% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 3% year-over-year and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals strong supply-side growth with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong supply growth with accommodative policy
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2% and S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.
